changes: Shared 18-entry inventory/world appearance catalog; inventory-only modifier tint removed.
Six distinct blade profiles and forged guards; sword length applied consistently to pickup, hand and scabbard meshes.
Pointed wooden/root and heater-shaped knight shields with large leaf/ivory-wing relief matching painted icons.
Wind boots use pale green cuffs, gold feather fittings and green ties; tunic pickup belt and worn cloth palette brought closer to painted art.
Overview, Compare and Details inspector tabs; modifier comparison hides unchanged values.
Character totals, testing and navigation moved into focused pages; backpack filters collapse; hover and drag tooltips are compact.
Recipes now select one recipe at a time; Escape returns from utility/forge views; equipment cards show their visible appearance name.

checks.normal_geometry: pass: 201466 nondegenerate triangles across 72 meshes; unit normals, bounds, base length ratios and appearance/socket resolution
native_ui: Equipment overview: compact stats and primary equip action visible.
Compare and Details tabs opened and displayed separately.
More page opened with character, forge, quest and testing destinations.
Click-to-equip swapped the selected sword and retained the old sword in backpack.
Final production More > Preview matching gear rendered matching pickups and equipped gear in Hyrule Field.
checks.blender: Runtime OBJ meshes inspected through local Blender MCP; standalone factory-startup review blend and rendered PNG generated.

limits: Held-button drag automation was not verified: raw SDL trace showed down/up at the source followed by unpressed movement. Existing ImGui drag path retained; experimental fallback and all temporary logging removed.
Worn tunics retain native animated body geometry with recoloring and ornaments; they are not complete replacement character costumes.
Different scene lighting affects perceived color; this is a silhouette/material identity pass, not new painted surface textures.
Final preview was left running after user interaction was observed.
